K-0 asserts url stays http://127.0.0.1:3000/kudos and h1 text. Live suite run: pass.

HIGHLIGHT KUDOS, SPOTLIGHT BOARD and ALL KUDOS sections all render with the eyebrow 'Sun* Annual Awards 2025' — VERIFIED. kudos-board.tsx and spotlight-board.tsx both read copy.eyebrow = dictionary.kudos.eyebrow, single source. K-2/K-13/K-17 each assert the eyebrow text inside their section. Live suite: pass.

Hashtag filter menu offers exactly 13 options and department filter menu exactly 48, verbatim from the dropdown frames — HASHTAG PART VERIFIED (13, live DB count and e2e HASHTAG_OPTIONS array both 13, order-checked by K-3). DEPARTMENT PART: the true, authoritative count is 50, not 48 — test-contract.md 'Blueprint ratification (2026-09-06c)' #6 documents that the original clarifications.md '(48 entries)' label was a miscount, corrected to 50 at source with CEVC10 excluded from the filter (its own department, absent from the dropdown frame). Live DB confirms 50 rows with filter_position set, CEVC10 is the 51st with filter_position NULL; e2e/fixtures/kudos-constants.ts DEPARTMENT_OPTIONS holds exactly 50 entries matching the DB verbatim, and K-3 asserts DEPARTMENT_OPTIONS.length dynamically (not the literal '48'). The built system is correct against the corrected, authoritative figure; the '48' in this criterion is a stale figure this same ratification fixed. Logged as a Low finding for traceability, not a functional defect.

Selecting a filter re-filters both the highlight carousel and the all-kudos feed, AND-combines, and resets the carousel to slide 1 — VERIFIED. Single filteredKudos = board.kudos.filter(matchesFilters) feeds both HighlightCarousel and AllKudosSection (kudos-board.tsx); matchesFilters (lib/kudos/derive.ts) requires both hashtag and department conditions to hold (AND); handleSelectHashtag/handleSelectDepartment both call setActiveSlide(0). K-8 asserts pagination returns to 1/N after a filter click. Live suite: pass.

Highlight carousel shows at most 5 slides ordered by heart count descending, with arrows disabled at each end and pagination text current/total — VERIFIED. pickHighlight() = [...cards].sort(hearts desc, id desc tiebreak).slice(0,5) in derive.ts, recomputed from filteredKudos on every render. K-4 (slide count <=5, aria-current/aria-hidden), K-5 (pagination regex), K-6 (prev/next disabled state) all pass live.

Kudos card renders sender, receiver, badge with its hoa-thi tooltip, timestamp, campaign label, hashtags, heart and Copy Link — VERIFIED. kudos-card.tsx composes SunnerChip x2, sunner-badge with badgeTooltipFor() title, kudos-time (formatSentAt, HH:mm - MM/DD/YYYY), kudos-campaign, KudosHashtagRow, KudosCardActions (heart + Copy Link). K-9 and K-11 assert this live.

Heart is disabled for an anon viewer and for the sender's own kudos; for a signed-in viewer it toggles aria-pressed and moves the count by exactly 1 — VERIFIED both in code and against the live database. board-data.ts: canLike = viewer.isAuthenticated && viewer.sunnerId !== row.sender.id (auth-only identity from lib/kudos/viewer.ts resolveViewer(), never the sidebar's seeded-viewer fallback). K-24 (every heart disabled, anon project) and K-10 (toggle flips aria-pressed and count by 1, then clicks back to original, kudos-authed project) both pass live. Self-like is additionally blocked at the RLS layer (kudos_likes_insert_own policy's NOT EXISTS join on sunners.auth_user_id), not only app-level — verified by reading the live policy via pg_policies.

Heart state persists across a page reload, proving the Supabase data layer is real rather than client state — VERIFIED. toggleKudosLike is server-authoritative (app/kudos/_actions/toggle-kudos-like.ts): the click handler awaits the server round trip before flipping local state, so a completed click means the row is already committed. K-25 (kudos-authed project) clicks, reloads, asserts the flipped value holds, clicks back, reloads again, asserts it returns to the original — real reload assertions, not simulated. Live DB: kudos_likes unique(kudos_id,user_id) constraint verified to genuinely reject a duplicate insert.

Copy Link writes the kudos URL to the clipboard and shows the toast 'Link copied - ready to share!' — VERIFIED. handleCopyClick in kudos-card-actions.tsx writes `${origin}/kudos/${id}` via navigator.clipboard.writeText, reports success/failure to the toast. COPY_LINK_TOAST constant = 'Link copied — ready to share!' matches vi/en dictionary toast.copySuccess. K-11 passes live with clipboard permissions granted.

Spotlight board renders 388 KUDOS, the seven seeded recipient names, the ticker, and its search narrows the nodes — VERIFIED. board_stats.spotlight_kudos_total seeded to 388 (confirmed live query), read by getSpotlightTotal(), never a live count(*) — matches ratification #Overridden. All 7 spotlight names are real sunners rows (Đỗ hoàng Hiệp .. Nguyễn Hoàng Linh, confirmed live). spotlight-word-cloud.tsx filters nodes client-side on the search string. K-13/K-14/K-15/K-16 pass live.

Sidebar renders the five stat rows in the exact recorded order plus the Mo Secret Box button and the gift leaderboard — VERIFIED. kudos-sidebar.tsx renders sidebar-stat rows in exactly the order kudosReceived, kudosSent, heartsReceived, secretBoxOpened, secretBoxUnopened — matches SIDEBAR_STATS constant and test-contract.md verbatim. secret-box-button links to /kudos/secret-box; gift-leaderboard renders the '10 SUNNER NHẬN QUÀ MỚI NHẤT' heading. K-18/K-19/K-20 pass live.

Every screen string ships in both vi and en, compile-time enforced by the Dictionary interface — VERIFIED. Dictionary interface (lib/i18n/messages/dictionary.ts) gained a required `kudos` namespace; vi.ts imports viKudos and en.ts imports enKudos, both fully populated (vi-kudos.ts 53 lines, en-kudos.ts 54 lines) — a missing key in either fails `tsc --noEmit`, and temper-results.json records typecheck exit 0.

All new schema is reachable only per RLS: select for anon and authenticated, insert and delete on kudos_likes restricted to auth.uid() — VERIFIED LIVE against the running database, not just migration text. `select policyname, roles, cmd, qual from pg_policies where schemaname='public'` shows: select-all (anon,authenticated) on all 10 tables; insert/delete on kudos_likes only, both to `authenticated`, both requiring `(select auth.uid()) = user_id`; insert additionally blocks self-like via a NOT EXISTS join to the kudos sender; no update policy exists anywhere. relrowsecurity=true on all 10 public tables. Empirically confirmed: `set local role anon; insert into kudos_likes ...` raises 'new row violates row-level security policy'; a duplicate (kudos_id,user_id) insert raises the real unique-constraint violation, not an app-level illusion; an UPDATE against kudos_likes as authenticated matches 0 rows (no update policy exists, default-deny). Broad GRANT ALL entries seen in information_schema.role_table_grants are Supabase's own platform-level default ACL (owned by supabase_admin, present before this migration ran) — RLS is the actual and effective gate, confirmed by the live tests above.

npm run typecheck, npm run lint and the kudos Playwright suite all exit 0 — VERIFIED via evidence/temper-results.json (real captured exit codes: typecheck 0, lint 0, build 0, db reset 0, kudos suite 27 passed/exit 0 run 4 times including once with no reset between runs, kudos_likes returns to 0 each time; 57 passed across every other shipped suite with 0 regressions) plus independent spot verification of the RLS/heart-toggle/seed-count claims those runs depend on.

Every new code file stays under the repo's 200-line cap — MET for all production code (largest: kudos-card.tsx 183, queries.ts 182, board-data.ts 180 lines; all app/kudos and lib/kudos files checked, none exceed 200). NOT met for one new test file: e2e/kudos-live-board.spec.ts is 616 lines. This mirrors an existing, already-shipped repo pattern — e2e/homepage.spec.ts (604), e2e/award-system.spec.ts (466) and e2e/login-screen.spec.ts (310) are all pre-existing files already over 200 lines — so this is a precedented convention for E2E spec files, not a new regression. Logged as a Low finding, not blocking.

supabase/seed.sql runs on db reset and e2e auth setup creates real auth users — verified seed.sql never writes to auth.users (confirmed by reading the file and the migration's FK comments); clarifications.md and temper-results.json both record that db reset is a pre-suite step only, never called mid-run, and the authenticated e2e specs (K-10, K-25, plus the pre-existing authenticated.spec.ts) pass in the same run.

app/kudos/page.tsx is the destination of the homepage nav and the KudosPromo CTA — homepage.spec.ts (part of the 57-test regression run) still passes in full; app/_components/home-header.tsx, app/_page-context.ts and the KudosPromo component are untouched by this feature (git status confirms none of app/_components/**, app/_page-context.ts appear in the changed-file list).

getPageContext and HomeHeader are shared chrome — confirmed untouched (absent from git status output); app/kudos/page.tsx composes them exactly as app/awards-information/page.tsx already does, passing only {locale, dictionary, isAuthenticated, isAdmin} into HomeHeader, never the raw Supabase user object.

The first RLS policies in the repo set the precedent every later table follows — reviewed the actual live policies (see acceptanceCovered #13): default-deny with explicit select-all + narrowly-scoped owner-only insert/delete is a sound precedent (least privilege, ownership enforced by auth.uid(), no update path, unique constraint backing the one-like-per-user rule). docs/system/architecture.md and docs/system/permissions.md were updated to describe this precedent and both match what is actually running in the database.

findings.summary: New E2E spec file is 616 lines, over the repo's 200-line file cap. Matches an existing, already-shipped pattern for large E2E spec files elsewhere in the repo (homepage.spec.ts 604, award-system.spec.ts 466, login-screen.spec.ts 310) — not a novel regression, but the cap is nominally still violated.

DEPARTMENT_OPTIONS carries a stale doc comment ('48 entries') and the K-3 test title still says 'department has 48', even though the array itself correctly holds 50 entries (matching the live, ratified-correct DB) and the assertion uses DEPARTMENT_OPTIONS.length dynamically rather than a hardcoded 48. Cosmetic only — no runtime effect.

resolveViewer() and resolveSidebarSunnerId() throw on any Supabase read failure rather than degrading, so a transient DB hiccup on this one query would 500 the whole /kudos page for every viewer rather than rendering the page with a fallback. Low likelihood (RLS grants select to anon on sunners) and not exercised by any acceptance criterion, but worth a graceful-degradation pass in a follow-up.
